claims.claim: Athanasius of Alexandria was Bishop of Alexandria.
Athanasius was born c. 296–298 and died on 2 May 373.
The Letter to Palladius is dated c. 372.
The letter was written to Palladius, a presbyter.
The monks at Caesarea were opposing their bishop Basil.
Athanasius had already intervened by letter for Basil's episcopal authority.
Athanasius asks Palladius to do the same and point out to the monks their duty of obeying Basil.
The letter is preserved in Migne's Patrologia Graeca 26, 1168 sq.
The letter has been translated into English by Archibald Robertson in NPNF 2, vol. 4 (1980), p. 580.
